summary: Every matchable effect now shows its level 2, its form when the card sits on the mark it matched, and every question was re-read for uniqueness and fun, with a pair reviewer reading each family again. 1,527 live questions, 270 retired in place (187 this round: duplicates, twins where one effect's level 2 was another's level 1, and premises the game does not have). 196 had options rewritten; 210 carry a one-line flag saying why the effect may not earn a slot; every skill, stamp and rank has a level 2 except five that cannot use one. Family AB is 19 new effects built around aiming at marks. Family AC (98 questions) asks the level 2 of each effect you had already ruled on, so no recorded answer changed meaning; its (d) keeps the effect with no level 2. Your rulings on round 2 are applied: fame is not spendable (a fame cost is now a skipped reward), and a property's level 2 is unlocked by its own match unless an effect says otherwise. Q0011 and Q0047 are still the only answered questions that are retired.
